job.title: SAP CPI / PDI Integration Developer (m/w/d) – SAP CX

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Developer | Integration, REST & Groovy APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, Groovy, middleware integrations, data pipelines, and cloud environments. Proven delivery of API integrations between PIM, ERP, MDM and CX systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, production troubleshooting, and agile international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP CPI / PDI Integration Developer (m/w/d) – SAP CX
cover_en.hook: Megapart GmbH's focus on modern SAP cloud technologies and international projects closely aligns with my enterprise integration expertise. Over 5+ years as a backend developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and optimized complex data flows and API connections across enterprise cloud landscapes.

bullets.label: API & Middleware Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed robust REST, SOAP and OCC web services, designing custom Interceptors and Converters for seamless data synchronization between SAP and non-SAP systems.

bullets.label: Data Flows & Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered complex integration pipelines using Hotfolders, DataHub, and Profisee to synchronize high-volume product catalogs and enterprise data across global platforms.

bullets.label: Cloud & Scripting Experience
bullets.text: Authored custom Groovy administrative scripts, managed cloud deployments via SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), and executed continuous integration deployment cycles.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business and technical stakeholders to analyse requirements, design architectural integration solutions, and support production go-lives.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my integration and backend expertise can support Megapart GmbH.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP CPI / PDI Integration Developer (m/w/d) – SAP CX
cover_de.hook: Die Fokussierung der Megapart GmbH auf moderne SAP-Cloud-Technologien und internationale Projekte passt exakt zu meiner langjährigen Integrations- und Backend-Erfahrung. In über 5 Jahren bei Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich erfolgreich komplexe Schnittstellen und Datenströme in verteilten Unternehmenslandschaften realisiert.

bullets.label: API- & Schnittstellenentwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von REST-, SOAP- und OCC-Webservices sowie Anpassung kundenspezifischer Datenflüsse mittels Interceptors und Converters.

bullets.label: Integrationsszenarien & Pipelines
bullets.text: Konzeption und Optimierung robuster Daten-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Hotfolders, DataHub und Profisee zur Synchronisation großer Datenmengen über Systemgrenzen hinweg.

bullets.label: Cloud & Scripting
bullets.text: Praktische Umsetzung von Automatisierungen mit Groovy-Skripten, Administration über Konsolen sowie Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployments in Cloud-Umgebungen (CCv2).

bullets.label: Techno-Funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Enger Austausch mit internationalen Fachabteilungen zur Anforderungsanalyse, Erstellung technischer Spezifikationen und Begleitung von Tests und Fehleranalysen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer ordentlichen Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026 (frühester Start am 16.12.2026). Gerne überzeuge ich Sie in einem persönlichen Gespräch von meinem Mehrwert für Ihr Team.

tailoring.why_company: Megapart GmbH offers an exciting environment working with modern SAP cloud technologies in international teams. My extensive background in building robust API integrations, data pipelines, and enterprise software solutions at scale enables me to hit the ground running and contribute effectively to your integration projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of enterprise backend and integration experience, I design and deliver scalable API solutions, data flows, and cloud-connected systems for global business environments.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years in enterprise backend and API integration development for global platforms, I bring strong expertise in REST/SOAP services, data pipelines, and cloud environments. I would love to contribute to Megapart GmbH's international SAP projects. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP CPI / PDI Integration Developer (m/w/d) – SAP CX – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the SAP CPI / PDI Integration Developer position at Megapart GmbH. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise integrations, robust APIs, and data pipelines in international environments, I am confident in my ability to add immediate value to your team.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my qualifications with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
